newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela 1996 inflation seen at 103 pct - Cen Bank.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela 1996 inflation seen at 103 pct - Cen Bank.

text.p: Venezuelan inflation for 1996 is seen at 103 percent, compared with 56.6 percent in 1995, according the Central Bank's annual review of the Venezuelan economy.

"This result recognizes the strong inflationary tendency of the first quarter of the year, as well as the corrective price adjustment that stemmed from the application of the economic program in April," Central Bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez said in the review.
"However, one has to point out the important declining trend in price increases from the second half of the year onwards, as foreseen in the economic package."
Venezuela launched an IMF-supported economic reform package in mid-April that saw inflation drop from a 12.6 percent peak in May to 3.1 percent in November.
